summary: Laser Photonics Corp filed an 8-K disclosing warrant inducement agreements with holders of existing Series A-5 and A-6 warrants. The company offered new Series A-7 and A-8 warrants exercisable at $0.975/share as an inducement to exercise the existing warrants for cash. Aggregate gross proceeds of $2,465,357.70 were received. H.C. Wainwright served as exclusive placement agent for a 7% cash fee and placement agent warrant. The filing primarily concerns an equity-linked capital raise, not a special situation. What to watch: this is a routine financing event with no change of control, strategic review, or restructuring.
